name: Devin Teichrow, MSc
profile: Epidemiologist and clinical research specialist with an MS in Epidemiology from UCLA and experience spanning neuroepidemiology, migraine, ADRD and cognitive aging, clinical trial data management, environmental epidemiology, health-services research, and public science communication. Brings applied quantitative analysis, protocol and IRB support, participant-facing research operations, manuscript and abstract writing, and clear translation of complex findings for clinical, research, and public audiences.

experience.title: Assistant Specialist
experience.organization: Neuroinformatics Lab, University of California, Irvine
bullets: Supported migraine, headache, digital cognitive testing, ecological momentary assessment, Alzheimer disease, and dementia-related research as an epidemiology and biostatistics analyst in Ali Ezzati, MD's Neuroinformatics Lab.

Analyzed real-world migraine and cognition data in R and Python, producing regression models, marginal-means estimates, g-method analyses, cohort summaries, manuscript-ready tables, figures, and investigator-facing reports.

Contributed analyses to four American Headache Society abstracts and multiple migraine manuscripts, including a first-author pharmacoepidemiology manuscript on real-world acute prescription migraine therapy outcomes.

Supported longitudinal cohort development, recruitment, progress tracking, data-quality review, and documentation for the Migraine and Cognition in Daily Life Study, including two completed recruitment phases.
Drafted and maintained protocols, IRB-related materials, consent and study-primer language, participant education, lab websites, research-output records, and public-facing UCI MIND communication.

Developed and presented "Digital Dementia: Is Technology Making Us Forgetful?" for the Alzheimer's Orange County Brain Health Conference, translating cognitive-aging evidence for public and professional audiences.

experience.title: Clinical Research Data Manager
bullets: Managed data collection, cleaning, maintenance, query resolution, quality assurance, and monitoring documentation for antifungal rezafungin clinical trials in bone marrow transplant patients.
Produced data-quality summaries, visualizations, and query-resolution materials for clinical-team review while supporting FDA, IRB, GCP, and study-protocol requirements.
Designed and maintained secure study databases and standardized data-management workflows to improve consistency, auditability, and analysis readiness.

experience.title: Food Rx and Related Research Master's Intern
bullets: Supported applied population-health and health-services research through data preparation, statistical analysis, project planning, reporting, and dissemination.
Prepared analyses, manuscript material, figures, presentations, and collaborator-facing summaries for research on nutrition, weight management, restaurant portions, and cardiovascular outcomes.
Developed intervention-facing nutrition materials and a dissemination-focused cookbook, including nutrition analysis, layout planning, and plain-language health communication.

experience.title: Graduate Student Researcher
bullets: Completed an epidemiology master's thesis on maternal exposure to airport-related particulate matter and risk of childhood cerebral palsy and epilepsy using a dataset with more than 200,000 participants and 50 variables.

Cleaned and analyzed data in R using logistic regression, sensitivity analyses, and visualization; supported literature review, protocol documentation, IRB-related form revisions, staff training, and onboarding.

Supported Parkinson's Environment and Genes research through participant interviews, recruitment, outreach, and data entry; completed MoCA certification/training and administered cognitive assessments in Parkinson's disease research.

experience.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
bullets: Supported longitudinal dementia-prevention research involving diet and exercise interventions, cognitive-health outcomes, older-adult participants, REDCap data entry, and participant-facing documentation.
Conducted strength and flexibility assessments in retirement-community settings and maintained real-time study records.

experience.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher and Thesis Advisee
experience.organization: Personality, Self, and Emotion Lab, UC Davis
bullets: Used R to estimate latent growth-curve and structural-equation models for longitudinal developmental psychology research; contributed to a published study and completed an honors thesis on personality development and childhood cognitive ability.

education.institution: UCLA Fielding School of Public Health
education.detail: Thesis: Maternal particulate-matter exposure from airport-related air pollution and risk of childhood cerebral palsy and epilepsy.
Undergraduate Research Award, Department of Psychology; honors thesis on longitudinal personality development and childhood cognitive ability.

communication.text: The Edge of Epidemiology: Founder and writer of an independent public-science publication on epidemiology, public health, disease ecology, infectious disease history, and the historical roots of modern health systems.
UCI MIND: Public-facing ADRD research translation, including "Personality Before Memory? When Subtle Changes Signal the Earliest Stages of Dementia."
Alzheimer's Orange County: Developed and presented "Digital Dementia: Is Technology Making Us Forgetful?" on dementia, technology, brain health, cognitive aging, and research literacy.

The Age of Exploration: Published "Slow collapse: How Eurasian diseases devastated the Americas" and developed interactive historical epidemiology maps, including the Norse Travels Health Map and American Revolution Health Atlas.
